5301.grammar: prp of na usūyati, neg, deno, intrans
5301.meaning1: not being jealous; not being irritated

examples.text: anusūyāyamāno so, samma'd'aññāya bhāsati, subhāsitaṃ anumodeyya, dubbhaṭṭhe n'āpasādaye.

5302.meaning1: (of a thing) underlies; inheres; is implicit; lies dormant

examples.text: evaṃ santaṃ kho, ānanda, rūpiṃ parittatt'ānudiṭṭhi anusetī'ti icc'ālaṃ vacanāya.

yā imā, cunda, anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti, attavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā lokavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā, yattha c'etā diṭṭhiyo uppajjanti yattha ca anusenti yattha ca samudācaranti taṃ n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na me so attā'ti

5303.meaning1: (of a person) has a tendency towards; is pre-occupied (with); is attached (to); (comm) persists
5303.commentary: (MNa) anusetī'ti appahīnatāya anuseti. anusayamāno saṃyojanaṃ nāma hoti. (SNa) anusetī'ti yañ'ca anusayaṃ anuseti, pavatteti'cc'eva attho.

examples.text: yañ'ca, bhikkhave, ceteti yañ'ca pakappeti yañ'ca anuseti, ārammaṇam'etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, anuseti taṃ anumīyati, yaṃ anumīyati tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati. yaṃ n'ānuseti na taṃ anumīyati, yaṃ n'ānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatī'ti. aññātaṃ, bhagavā, aññātaṃ, sugatā'ti.

5304.commentary: (THIa) tāsaṃ kam'anusocasī'ti tāsu jīvantīnāmāsu caturāsītisahassamattāsu kaṃ sandhāya tvaṃ anusocasi anusokaṃ āpajjasī'ti

examples.text: amma jīvā'ti vanamhi kandasi, attānaṃ adhigaccha ubbiri, cull'āsītisahassāni, sabbā jīvasanāmikā, etamh'āḷāhane daḍḍhā, tāsaṃ kam'anusocasi.
anāgatappajappāya, atītassa-anusocanā, etena bālā sussanti, naḷo'va harito luto'ti.

5308.meaning1: along the stream; downstream; with the flow

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? anusotagāmī puggalo, paṭisotagāmī puggalo, ṭhit'atto puggalo, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.

5309.meaning1: going with the stream; headed downstream; going with the flow

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, anusotagāmī puggalo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme ca paṭisevati, pāpañ'ca kammaṃ karoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anusotagāmī puggalo.
ye keci kāmesu asaññatā janā, avītarāgā idha kāmabhogino, punappunaṃ jātijar'ūpagāmi te, taṇh'ādhipannā anusotagāmino.

5310.meaning1: both upstream and downstream; with and against the current

examples.text: so tattha anusotam'pi vuyhati, paṭisotam'pi vuyhati, anusotapaṭisotam'pi vuyhati. so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.

5312.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anusota
5312.meaning1: following the stream; with the current
5312.construction:
anu + √su > so + ta + aṃ
anusota + aṃ

examples.text: so tattha anusotam'pi vuyhati, paṭisotam'pi vuyhati, anusotapaṭisotam'pi vuyhati. so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.

5314.meaning1: excellency of remembrance; best kind of recollection
5314.commentary: (DNa) khattiy'ādīnaṃ guṇ'ānussaraṇaṃ n'ānussat'ānuttariyaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ pana ratanānaṃ guṇ'ānussaraṇaṃ anussat'ānuttariyaṃ nāma. (ANa) ānandatthero'y'eva ca dasabalassa lokiyalok'uttare guṇe anussarati, idaṃ anussat'ānuttariyaṃ.

examples.text: cha anuttariyāni, dassan'ānuttariyaṃ, savan'ānuttariyaṃ, lābh'ānuttariyaṃ, sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ, pāricariy'ānuttariyaṃ, anussat'ānuttariyaṃ.

5315.commentary: (SNa) anussatin'ti rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭṭhānesu nisinnassa idāni ariyā leṇa-guha-maṇḍap'ādīsu jhāna-vipassanā-magga-phala-sukhehi vītināmentī'ti anussaraṇaṃ. yo vā tesaṃ santike ovādo laddho hoti, taṃ āvajjitvā imasmiṃ ṭhāne sīlaṃ kathitaṃ, imasmiṃ samādhi, imasmiṃ vipassanā, imasmiṃ maggo, imasmiṃ phalan'ti evaṃ anussaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: payirupāsanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi, anussatim'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi, anupabbajjam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi.
so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigat'ūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsa-anussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ

5316.meaning1: subject for recollection; basis for remembrance
5316.commentary: (DNa) anussatiyo'va anussatiṭṭhānāni nāma. (ANa) anussatiṭṭhānānī'ti anussatikāraṇāni. (ANa) idaṃ, bhante, anussatiṭṭhānan'ti idaṃ jhānattayasaṅkhātaṃ anussatikāraṇaṃ.

examples.text: buddh'ānussati, dhamm'ānussati, saṅgh'ānussati, sīl'ānussati, cāg'ānussati, devat'ānussati, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cha anussatiṭṭhānānī'ti.
idāni yathā tassa bhikkhuno anussarato so aveccappasādo uppanno, taṃ vidhiṃ dassento iti'pi so bhagavā'ti-ādinā nayena tīṇi anussatiṭṭhānāni vitthāresi.

5319.meaning2: Chapter on Recollection; Chapter 2 of Ekādasakanipāta, Aṅguttara Nikāya 11.11-21

examples.text: akkodhanaṃ vatavantaṃ, sīlavantaṃ anussadaṃ, dantaṃ antimasārīraṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
upekkhako sadā sato, na loke maññate samaṃ, na visesī na nīceyyo, tassa no santi ussadā.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto agginā asantatto anukkudhito anussadakajāto. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ pajāneyya passeyya.
ye me petā ñātī sālohitā kālaṅ'katā pasannacittā anussaranti tesaṃ taṃ mahapphalaṃ assa mah'ānisaṃsan'ti
araññe rukkhamūle vā, suññ'āgāre'va bhikkhavo, anussaretha sambuddhaṃ, bhayaṃ tumhāka no siyā.
kasmā nu saccāni vadanti nānā, pavādiyāse kusalā vadānā, saccāni sutāni bahūni nānā, udāhu te takkam'anussaranti.

5328.commentary: (ANa) pubbenivāsaṃ anussarantānan'ti pubbe nivutthakkhandhasantānaṃ anussaraṇasamatthānaṃ sobhitatthero aggo'ti dasseti. so kira pubbenivāsaṃ anupaṭipāṭiyā anussaramāno pañca kappasatāni asaññibhave acittakapaṭisandhiṃ nayato aggahesi ākāse padaṃ dassento viya. tasmā pubbenivāsaṃ anussarantānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: saritvā pubbake yogī, tesaṃ vattam'anussaraṃ, kiñ'c'āpi pacchimo kālo, phuseyya amataṃ padaṃ.
tassa attano ca tāsañ'ca devatānaṃ saddhañ'ca sīlañ'ca sutañ'ca cāgañ'ca paññañ'ca anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti
evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti, iti vā hi, bhikkhave, anussaramāno rūpaṃ'y'eva anussarati
tena kho pana samayena candimā devaputto rāhunā asur'indena gahito hoti. atha kho candimā devaputto bhagavantaṃ anussaramāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

5330.commentary: (THa) pañca kappasatān'āhaṃ, ekarattiṃ anussarin'ti ekarattiṃ viya anussariṃ. viya-saddo hi idha luttaniddiṭṭho, etena pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇe attano ñāṇavasībhāvaṃ dīpeti.

examples.text: satimā paññavā bhikkhu, āraddhabalavīriyo, pañca kappasatān'āhaṃ, ekarattiṃ anussariṃ.
bhikkhunī upasampajja, pubbajātim'anussariṃ, dibbacakkhu visodhitaṃ, vimalaṃ sādhubhāvitaṃ.

5332.meaning1: should be remembered; should be recollected

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, na anussaritabbo dhammo? micchāvimutti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, na anussaritabbo dhammo.

5335.meaning1: who re-remembers; who recollects; who bears in mind

examples.text: saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ satimā bhavissati, paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatam'pi cirabhāsitam'pi saritā anussaritā.

seyyathā'pi dovāriko hoti paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā, evam'evaṃ kho ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatam'pi cirabhāsitam'pi saritā anussaritā.
ahañ'hi, bhante, yāvatakam'pi me iminā attabhāvena paccanubhūtaṃ tam'pi nappahomi sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anussarituṃ, kuto pan'āhaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarissāmi

5339.meaning1: hearsay; what one has heard; oral tradition

examples.text: etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.

saddhā, ruci, anussavo, ākāraparivitakko, diṭṭhinijjhānakkhanti, ime kho, bhāradvāja, pañca dhammā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dvedhā vipākā. api ca, bhāradvāja, susaddahitaṃ'y'eva hoti, tañ'ca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā, no ce'pi susaddahitaṃ hoti, tañ'ca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.

5342.meaning1: whose faith is based on hearsay
5342.meaning2: whose faith is based on hearsay
5342.commentary: (ANa) anussavappasannānan'ti anussaven'eva uppannena pasādena samannāgatānaṃ upāsikānaṃ antare, kāḷī upāsikā, kuraragharikā aggā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ anussavappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ kāḷī upāsikā kulagharikā'ti.

5343.meaning1: accepting tradition as true; believing in oral tradition
5343.meaning2: depending on tradition for one's truths; accepting tradition as true
5343.commentary: (MNa) anussaviko hotī'ti anussavanissito hoti. anussavasacco'ti savanaṃ saccato gahetvā ṭhito.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sandaka, idh'ekacco satthā anussaviko hoti anussavasacco. so anussavena itih'itihaparam'parāya piṭakasampadāya dhammaṃ deseti.

so kho pan'assa āyasmā sāmaṃ diṭṭho vā hoti anussavassuto vā, evaṃsīlo so āyasmā ahosi iti'pi, evaṃdhammo so āyasmā ahosi iti'pi, evaṃpañño so āyasmā ahosi iti'pi, evaṃvihārī so āyasmā ahosi iti'pi, evaṃvimutto so āyasmā ahosi iti'pī'ti.

5346.meaning1: traditionalist; who repeats what one has heard; who follows the Vedic tradition

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sandaka, idh'ekacco satthā anussaviko hoti anussavasacco. so anussavena itih'itihaparam'parāya piṭakasampadāya dhammaṃ deseti.

5347.grammar: abs of na ussādeti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
5347.meaning1: having not praised; having not flattered
5347.meaningLit: having not caused to sink up
5347.construction:
na > an + ud + sāde + tvā
na + ussādetvā

examples.text: so n'eva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo, anussādetvā anapasādetvā sv'eva sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo tassa ca atthassa tesañ'ca byañjanānaṃ nisantiyā.

5349.meaning2: who proclaims (the legal action); who presents for upasampadā

5350.meaning2: causing to be heard, sounding; proclamation (especially of a legal action)

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū evarūpāni kammāni karonti, adhammena vaggakammaṃ karonti, adhammena samaggakammaṃ karonti, dhammena vaggakammaṃ karonti, dhammapatirūpakena vaggakammaṃ karonti, dhammapatirūpakena samaggakammaṃ karonti, ñattivipannam'pi kammaṃ karonti anussāvanasampannaṃ…

5351.meaning2: canvassing, speaking repeatedly (in order to win support)

5352.meaning2: causes to be heard; speaks out; proclaims (especially a legal action); presents (someone) for upasampadā; speaks repeatedly (in order to win support)

5354.grammar: pr, pass of anusāveti, caus, trans (+acc)
5354.meaning1: is announced; is declared; is stated
5354.meaning2: is announced; is declared; is stated

5355.grammar: prp of anussāviyati, caus, pass, intrans
5355.meaning1: being announced; being declared; being stated

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu, yāvatatiyaṃ anussāviyamāne, saramāno santiṃ āpattiṃ n'āvikareyya, sampajānamusāvād'assa hoti.

5356.meaning2: causes to be heard; speaks out; proclaims (esp. a kammavācā)
5356.commentary: (SNa) saddam'anussāvesī'ti seṭṭhissa ussāhaṃ janessāmī'ti suvaṇṇakiṅkiṇikaṃ ghaṭṭento viya madhurassarena saddaṃ anussāvesi.

5357.commentary: (SNa) saddam'anussāvesī'ti seṭṭhissa ussāhaṃ janessāmī'ti suvaṇṇakiṅkiṇikaṃ ghaṭṭento viya madhurassarena saddaṃ anussāvesi.

5358.meaning1: speaks repeatedly (in order to win support)

examples.text: dīghassa parajanassa yakkhassa saddaṃ sutvā bhummā devā saddam'anussāvesuṃ, lābhā vata bho vajjīnaṃ
tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā yāmā devā saddam'anussāvesum
atha kho āyasmā bhaddāli bhagavatā sikkhāpade paññāpiyamāne bhikkhusaṅghe sikkhaṃ samādiyamāne anussāhaṃ pavedesi.
taṃ kathaṃ kathaye dhīro, aviruddho anussito, anunnatena manasā, apaḷāso asāhaso.

5362.meaning1: not zealously desiring; not ambitious; not anxiously striving; calm; relaxed; unagitated
5362.commentary: (DHPa) pañcakāmaguṇapariyesane ussukesu tāya pariyesanāya abhāvena anussukā'ti. (SNa) anussukā'ti avāvaṭā.

examples.text: susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, ussukesu anussukā, ussukesu manassesu, viharāma anussukā.
hitvā agāraṃ pabbajitā, hitvā puttaṃ pasuṃ viyaṃ, hitvā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, avijjañ'ca virājiya, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, te lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.
suvihitāna dassanan'ti suvihitānaṃ dassanaṃ. gāthāsukh'atthaṃ anusvāralopo kato.

5370.meaning1: who follows; who acts according to; who is obedient

examples.text: dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vasa-anuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.
cakka-anuvattako thero, mahāñāṇī samāhito, pathav'āp'aggisamāno, na rajjati na dussati.

5372.meaning2: who follows or acts according to
5372.commentary: (VIN 1.2.11) anuvattakā'ti yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko te'pi taṃdiṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.

examples.text: tass'eva kho pana bhikkhussa bhikkhū honti anuvattakā vaggavādakā eko vā dve vā tayo vā
yadā kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā jhattā assu kilantā, atha kho yo nesaṃ pāṇakānaṃ balavataro assa tassa te anuvatteyyuṃ, anuvidhāyeyyuṃ vasaṃ gaccheyyuṃ.

5375.meaning1: twisting around; twining; winding around; encircling
5375.commentary: (THa) taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattanin'ti bahuvidhañ'ca ārammaṇaṃ bhavam'eva vā anuvattati santanotī'ti bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, taṇhāsaṅkhātalataṃ.

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidha-anuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.

5378.meaning2: causes to go on after, keeps in motion; maintains, continues

5381.meaning2: to be followed; to be conformed to

examples.text: evaṃ dhammā apakkamma, adhammam'anuvattiya, mando maccumukhaṃ patto, akkhacchinno'va jhāyatī'ti.

5383.meaning1: following; acting according to; obedient to
5383.meaning2: siding in with, who follows or acts according to

examples.text: ye tuyha chandena vasena vattino, narā ca nārī ca anubhonti yaṃ sukhaṃ, aviddasū māravasa-anuvattino, bhav'ābhinandī tava citta sāvakā'ti.
ye ca kho samma'd'akkhāte, dhamme dhamma-anuvattino, te janā pāram'essanti, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.

5384.meaning1: causes to roll on; keeps (something) moving along
5384.meaning2: continues rolling, wields power in succession

examples.text: ko nu senāpati bhoto, sāvako satthuranvayo, ko te tam'anuvatteti, dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ.

5385.meaning2: continued rolling, wielded power in succession

5389.grammar: prp of pass of anu √vad, intrans (+instr)

5391.meaning1: having continued staying; having remained living

5393.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anuvassa

5396.meaning1: makes re-recite; teaches what has been taught
5396.meaning2: recites after or again; teaches what has been taught

examples.text: kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, ye'pi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesam'idaṃ eta'r'ahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitam'anubhāsanti vācitam'anuvācenti

5398.meaning1: with and against the wind; windward and leeward

examples.text: mūlagandho, sāragandho, pupphagandho, imāni kho, bhante, tīṇi gandhajātāni, yesaṃ anuvātaṃ'y'eva gandho gacchati, no paṭivātaṃ. atthi nu kho, bhante, kiñci gandhajātaṃ yassa anuvātam'pi gandho gacchati, paṭivātam'pi gandho gacchati, anuvātapaṭivātam'pi gandho gacchatī'ti?

5399.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anuvāta
5399.meaning1: with the wind; in the direction of the wind; leeward
5399.meaning2: in the direction of the wind

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhante, gandhajātāni, yesaṃ anuvātaṃ'y'eva gandho gacchati, no paṭivātaṃ. katamāni tīṇi?
